# YouClean Travel Hand Soap Sheets, Tea Party Scent

## Clean Hands, Wherever You Go

Keep your hands fresh on every trip. These travel hand soap sheets fit easily in a purse, wallet, backpack, or pocket, so you can wash up on a train, at a campsite, or between classes. Add a little water and rub to create a foaming lather.

## Compact, Zero-Waste Design

Each collection includes three small paper boxes holding 100 sheets each. The lightweight packaging is plastic-free and biodegradable, so you can carry a supply that's always within reach without adding plastic waste.

## Gentle Plant-Based Care

Made with plant-based ingredients and flower and fruit essential oils, each sheet dissolves into a lather that leaves skin feeling moisturized. Use it on your hands, or as a shampoo or body wash when you need one.

## Scents for Every Setting

Choose from a range of collections. The Tea Party blend combines chamomile, green tea, and tea tree for a fresh, herbal scent. For professional settings, The Nonsense is unscented. Each scent keeps your bag or pocket smelling pleasant throughout the day.

## Stock Up for Your Next Trip

Add a YouClean collection to your cart today and keep clean hands close by wherever your adventures take you.
